examples.text: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

"Eunice," he said consideringly.
She paused in the midst of licking a dab of frosting off one finger.
"Properly speaking," he said, "it should be 'You-nike-ee'. That's the way Greeks would have said it."
"You-niss is bad enough," she told him. "I've always hated my name."
"Oh, it's a fine name. It means 'victorious'."

raw_glosses: (Greek mythology) A minor goddess, governing law, order and lawmaking; one of the Horae, she is a daughter of Zeus and Themis, and her sisters are Eirene (Peace) and Dike (Justice); her Roman counterpart is Disciplina.
